name: Horoz Lojistik Kargo Hizmetleri ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
summary: Horoz Lojistik Kargo Hizmetleri Ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi is a logistics firm with operations both within Turkey and globally. Their comprehensive transportation offerings encompass international road, air, and sea freight, along with national and international rail transport. They also handle intermodal solutions, full truckload domestic shipping, and specialized distribution for general goods and furniture, as well as project cargo. Beyond moving goods, the company provides diverse warehousing options, including traditional, shared dealer, e-commerce, and furniture storage. Their digital services include e-export, e-commerce logistics, the horoz wallet, and Alibaba membership. Additional provisions include furniture assembly and SSH, expert project management and consulting, and customs and insurance facilitation. Established in 1942, this company is based in Istanbul, Turkey.
